name: traceml
description: Read-only, filesystem-only viewer for ML training runs (tables, plots, comparison) inside VS Code. Works over Remote-SSH.

traceml.roots.markdownDescription: The runs folders TraceML reads. Each entry is a folder whose direct sub-folders are runs: an absolute path (`/data/me/runs`, `D:\runs`) or a path relative to each workspace folder (`runs`, `outputs/runs`). Nothing else is scanned, and TraceML never reads outside these folders.

traceml.staleAfterSeconds.markdownDescription: A `running` run whose `heartbeat_at` is older than this is shown as `stale`.

traceml.maxPointsPerSeries.markdownDescription: Series longer than this are downsampled with min/max-preserving buckets before plotting.

traceml.maxMetricsFileMB.markdownDescription: At most this many megabytes of each plotted run's `metrics.jsonl` are loaded into memory. Larger files are plotted partially with a warning.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Browse the ML training runs found in this workspace.
[Open Experiments](command:traceml.showExperiments)
[Refresh](command:traceml.refresh)
Runs are found under directories matching the [traceml.roots](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22traceml.roots%22%5D) setting.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies
